:clipboard: Release Notes — Deploy #515 (2026-08-13)

New Features

Rates History: "Matched On" Indicator
Rate History entries now show exactly why a rate card matched a job — displaying the matching conditions (e.g., truck type, material, equipment) as chips beneath each rate change. Makes it easier to understand rate behavior and resolve billing disputes.

───

Improvements

• AI timesheet scanning now writes extracted text to the correct fields, improving accuracy when reviewing AI-processed timesheets
• You can now add rate cards to completed orders — previously the "Add another rate" button was incorrectly hidden after an order was marked complete

───

Bug Fixes

• Fixed a deadlock that could cause invoice rate updates to fail during pricing cascades — affected orders now process reliably
• Fixed pickup/drop-off site changes on jobs not cascading to unfinished loads and not triggering driver notifications
• Fixed project foremen, collaborators, and salespeople not propagating to orders created via integrations — previously, integration-created orders were missing these contacts
• Fixed equipment capacity and load-count fields not saving when selecting an equipment type on order and project forms
• Fixed date and time editing issues on Projects where adjustments could produce unexpected results
• Fixed the rate cascade dialog incorrectly appearing when no rate changes were actually made
• Fixed payables rate changes failing with a generic error instead of surfacing the real validation issue
• Fixed several order form fields (notes, contract/dispatch/PO numbers, department, material rates, tax rates, and site contacts) that could appear updated in the form but silently fail to persist on save

───

In Progress (not yet customer-facing)

• 2-Way Chat — Backend messaging channels API shipped; frontend UI and mobile integration in development
• Site-Based Material/PO Linking — Backend phase resolution and frontend New Order cascade shipped behind feature flag; terminal selector still in development
• AI Timesheet Drawer Redesign — Backend structured metadata endpoint shipped; frontend expandable AI-metadata panel in development

:clipboard: Release Notes — Deploy #514 (2026-08-12)

Improvements

AI Timesheet Scanning: Smarter AM/PM Detection
The AI scanner now uses contextual clues (total hours, typical shift patterns) to correctly determine whether extracted times are AM or PM — previously it could misread afternoon times as early morning.

Tread Agent: AI-Generated Conversation Titles
Conversations with the Tread in-app agent now get a short AI-summarized title instead of showing the first 60 characters of your message, making it easier to find past conversations.

Order Ingest API: Multi-Material Support
The /ingest/orders API endpoint now accepts a materials array, allowing integration partners to send multiple materials with quantities and units on a single order — matching the existing project ingest capability.

───

Bug Fixes

• Fixed "Running" toggle turning off when job quantity is cleared (P0) — editing an order and clearing the truck quantity no longer silently disables the Running flag and resets jobs to 1 load
• Fixed payables rate save failing with a generic error — vendor rate changes on the Payables tab could fail repeatedly with an unhelpful message; the real validation issue is now surfaced clearly
• Fixed rate cascade dialog appearing when no rate changes were made — creating an order from an existing order no longer incorrectly triggers the "Apply rate changes to existing orders" prompt
• Fixed order form edits not saving correctly — several fields (notes, contract/dispatch/PO numbers, department, material rates, tax rates from schedules, and site contacts) could appear updated in the form but silently fail to persist on save; all now save reliably
• Fixed order form showing removed project foremen — changing a project on an existing order no longer re-adds foremen, collaborators, and salespeople that were previously removed
• Fixed "Rates Set" indicator showing incorrectly — orders with zero rate cards no longer display the indicator, and shared (connected-company) orders no longer fire failed rate card lookups on hover
• Fixed Customer Rate not displaying on multi-rate-card projects — orders with multiple unapplied rate cards now correctly suppress the Customer Rate field instead of showing a misleading single value
• Fixed invoice-approved rate edits not locking on the counterparty side — approving a dispatch-edge invoice now correctly locks rates on both sides of the transaction
• Fixed dispatch number search error for viewer-only users — a SQL error that broke the dispatch number typeahead for viewer-only users has been resolved

───

In Progress (not yet customer-facing)

• 2-Way Chat — Backend messaging channels API (job, order, broadcast, and private channel types with reply routing) shipped; frontend UI and mobile integration not started
• Site-Based Material/PO Linking — Backend phase resolution and frontend New Order cascade shipped behind a feature flag; terminal selector on project phase-code rows still in development
• AI Timesheet Drawer Redesign — Backend structured metadata endpoint shipped; frontend expandable AI-metadata panel (matching Ticket Drawer V2) in development

:clipboard: Release Notes — Mobile v1.117.0 (2026-08-10)

New Features

Cascade Rate Changes on Mobile
The "Apply rate changes to existing orders" checkbox is now available on the Create, Copy & Edit, and Edit order forms in the mobile app. Before saving, an impact bottom sheet shows exactly which orders and jobs will be affected by the rate change, so you can review before confirming.

Order Form Draft Autosave
Order forms now survive backgrounding the app — if you switch to another app or take a call mid-form, your in-progress input is preserved when you return. Both foreman and dispatcher create-order forms are covered. A save/discard prompt appears when you navigate away via the back button or gesture.

───

Improvements

• Timesheet forms (Job + Time Log) restyled with cleaner headers showing the order name or time log date for context, plus a new Total Hours field on the Time Log form
• Digital tickets now capture where the driver was when they saved, so the server can stamp the ticket with GPS coordinates for auditing
• Site addresses are tap-to-copy again
• Removed the "Synced with Project", "Frozen on Complete", and "Stamped to Order" chips from the order form rates section for a cleaner layout
• Simplified foreman order form for select customers — trimmed fields, Project required, start time defaults to 7 AM (behind a feature flag)

───

Bug Fixes

• Financial rates no longer leak to Foremen on the order/job detail screens or in the Create, Edit, and Copy & Edit order forms
• Offline sync no longer discards a driver's queued write when the server returns an error — queued changes are now retried correctly
• Improved error messages on the Time Log timesheet form (previously showed a generic "Error saving file attachment" message)
• iOS minimum raised to 16.0, matching what the app actually supports (it was previously offered to iOS 15.6 devices that couldn't run it)
• Sentry bug fixes and stability improvements

───

In Progress (not yet customer-facing)

• Rate Visibility Overhaul — Server-side rate field omission and three-permission model in backlog; will replace all ad-hoc client-side rate hiding
• Digital Ticket Hardening — Location capture shipped; geofence flagging for tickets created far from the dropoff site coming next

Freight Rate Cascade Fix
Orders with project-level freight rate cards could get permanently stuck at stale rates when the project's rates were updated. Affected orders were invisible to the rate cascade and couldn't be corrected through the impact dialog. This fix marks the legacy rate cards correctly so the cascade can reach them and they become visible and recoverable in the UI.

───

:clipboard: Release Notes — Deploy #507 (2026-08-05)

New Features

Consolidated Settlement Creation
Parent companies can now create consolidated settlements that roll up billing-approved work from child terminals into a single settlement per customer. A Location column has also been added to the Invoices grid for location-based filtering, matching the existing Settlements grid.

"Apply Rate Changes" Checkbox on All Order Forms
The "Apply rate changes to existing orders" checkbox is now available on the Create Order, Copy & Edit Order, and completed order forms — previously it only appeared when editing an existing order.

───

Improvements

• Rates History now shows entries for jobs that inherit rates from their parent order — these previously appeared blank
• Tread ID column added to the Customers tab in Settings, making it easy to identify connected companies at a glance

───

Bug Fixes

• Fixed orders losing pickup and dropoff sites when copying
• Fixed duplicated orders without a project losing their order-scoped rate cards
• Fixed rate changes incorrectly applying to existing orders when the "Apply rate changes" checkbox was unchecked
• Fixed the rate cascade modal showing orders outside the selected date range
• Fixed the "Use vendor rate for driver rate" checkbox re-checking itself on saved rates and not functioning
• Fixed fuel surcharge percentage in Edit Rates showing today's rate instead of the rate for the job's date
• Fixed scrolling inside the freight rates form unintentionally changing number values
• Fixed shared driver typeahead in hot-dispatch showing drivers that couldn't be assigned due to company hierarchy
• Fixed Job ID in reports showing a prefixed format instead of the numeric value
• Fixed report approval timestamps becoming stale after rapid consecutive changes

───

In Progress (not yet customer-facing)

• Live ETA to Site — Backend fully complete; frontend opt-in controls and dispatch board column in review
• Multiple Material Totals on Orders — Backend shipped; frontend display and order form entry coming next

:clipboard: Release Notes — Deploy #505 (2026-07-30)

New Features

Material Rate Auto-Population
The order form now automatically fills the correct material buy/sell price based on the most specific matching rate. When multiple rates exist for a material, the system picks the right one by customer, project, and site specificity — so the most targeted rate always wins.

───

Rate Visibility Controls for Drivers
Admins can now set "Hide Rates" on driver-role users from the driver creation and edit forms. This allows drivers to keep their role while being prevented from seeing financial rate information.

───

Improvements

• Rates History — Event descriptions now show the rate card name, rule, and job number; the full timeline loads instead of truncating at 25 records; and internal system rows are filtered out
• Rate card provenance on hover in the dispatch jobs table — see which rate card each party's rate came from; plus a new "Rates Set" indicator on project and order cards
• Material Rates panel added to the Site form for viewing, adding, and editing rates in place
• Default pickup/dropoff sites now shown inline below site selectors
• "Each" unit of measure added for orders
• Resend email/SMS invitations now available for drivers in Settings
• Exact search filters for ticket number, order number, or TRD ID independently
• Add-ons can now be deleted from Settings
• "Ask Tread" assistant docked as a bottom bar — no longer overlaps page actions
• Simplified rate card creation form (removed unused Equipment, Equipment Type, and Service Class fields)

───

Bug Fixes

• Fixed shift auto-end incorrectly ending drivers' shifts while still on active jobs
• Fixed a crash when typing a date in the rate-change impact drawer
• Fixed a permission issue where unpermitted rate changes could silently cascade to all orders
• Fixed multiple issues with project rate dereference when unchecking orders from rate changes
• Fixed pickup-site edits not propagating to child loads, causing stale pricing
• Fixed company and billing contact names not saving in company settings
• Fixed default country incorrectly set to Canada instead of United States
• Fixed project form not pre-filling default Quote PDF terms
• Fixed address suggestions being silently dropped on the project form
• Fixed ticket AI vision discarding valid service dates when no time was extracted
• Fixed dark mode rendering issues on Shift approval tab and timesheet scanning overlay
• Fixed errors during order duplication

───

In Progress (not yet customer-facing)

• Live ETA to Site — Backend infrastructure complete; live dispatch board ETA column behind feature flag
• Site-Based Material/PO Linking — Foundation shipped; terminal-based PO resolution in progress

:clipboard: Release Notes — Deploy #500 (2026-07-22)

New Features

Selective Rate Apply — Impact Side Sheet & Order-Level Cascade
Major expansion of the Selective Rate Apply feature. The rate-change impact preview now opens as a detailed side sheet showing affected orders with dispatch number, status, and site info. Admins can filter by date range and selectively exclude orders. Add-on changes and rate card additions/deletions now trigger the impact dialog (not just rate-value edits), and the cascade now works at the order level — not just from the project form.

Customer Account Promotion Tool
Platform admins can promote a customer account to a fully connected company. The tool handles invoice remapping, accounting ID and external ID carry-over, and job visibility backfill in one workflow.

Live Map: Color-Coded Truck Pins
New "Color trucks by destination" toggle on the Live Map. Truck pins are color-coded by load phase (heading to pickup vs heading to dropoff), making fleet status visible at a glance.

Driver & Vendor Onboarding Banners
The Drivers and Vendors pages now display collapsible share banners with quick links to the Tread driver mobile app and vendor onboarding guide.

───

Improvements

• Hauler rate type card now available on Order Form V3 and Project Form V2
• Standardized search date filter persistence across the app (rolling out)
• Navigation tabs now respond to clicks across the full tab area, eliminating dead clicks
• Dispatch list auto-refresh no longer causes flicker or list jumps
• Driver activation status now exposed on the API (enables resend-invitation flow)
• Soft-deleted records (Projects, Orders, Jobs, Tickets) now retrievable via API
• Ticket file attachments now use soft delete to prevent accidental data loss

───

Bug Fixes

• Fixed job-level add-on changes not applying to invoice when project rate card is enabled
• Fixed load approvals not reflecting in real time on Load Reports
• Fixed order rematch reverting a manual vendor rate pin without re-syncing the payable invoice
• Fixed duplicate order incorrectly copying job add-ons
• Fixed order update crashing when a waypoint has an empty contact
• Fixed order update failing when saving with empty phases
• Fixed load completion failing when a driver's shift was concurrently ended
• Fixed stale text-to-accept SMS reply causing errors when the job had already advanced
• Fixed app crashing on sign-out or session expiry
• Fixed "Failed to assign vendor" error when double-clicking Assign on an already-dispatched job
• Fixed Driver Pay settlements form crash when settlement data loads asynchronously
• Fixed project form customer account field going blank after inline account creation
• Fixed project form v3 missing on-the-fly customer and material creation
• Fixed project form v3 missing quote terms and broken create department dropdown
• Fixed geofence pipeline errors for jobs with recurring loads

───

In Progress (not yet customer-facing)

• Dark Mode (Web) — Semantic token layer, theme switch, and full color migration complete behind feature flag; pending QA and rollout
• AI Route Segmentation from GPS — AI-powered job/load summaries with GPS-based stop detection, admin map overlay, and manual trigger; internal/admin only behind feature flag
• Configurable Export Columns + PDF — Column picker and PDF export for Dispatch Orders behind feature flag; Approvals surfaces to follow
• 2-Way Chat — Backend rate limiting infrastructure complete; Stream Chat vendor SDK removed in preparation for in-house messaging
• Tread In-app Chat Agent — Backend message actions and chat dock, in early development
• AI Timesheet Processing — Phase 2 AI vision extraction on uploaded timesheets behind feature flag

New Features

In-App Turn-by-Turn Navigation
Drivers can now get turn-by-turn navigation for default job routes directly in the app, without switching to a separate maps app. Rolling out in phases.

Expanded Offline Editing
Drivers can now edit load and ticket notes, and manage signatures while offline — extending the offline capabilities introduced in the previous release.

Timesheet attachments now automatically capture the time ticket number in its own dedicated field using AI scanning, making it easier for back-office to locate and match timesheets.

• Foremen can no longer see customer or vendor rates on order and job detail screens
• Ticket Approver role now displays correctly on mobile

:clipboard: Release Notes — Deploy #497 (2026-07-16)

New Features

Selective Rate Apply for Projects
New project-level toggle "Apply rate changes to existing orders" lets admins control whether project rate changes cascade to existing orders or only apply to new ones. Orders can be pinned to their current rates when project pricing is updated.

Ticket Approver Role
New dedicated role for team members who review and approve loads. Ticket Approvers can view orders, jobs, and loads, and manage load approvals — without access to settings or other configuration.

AI Ticket Scanning Custom Instructions
Admins can now add custom instructions for AI-powered ticket scanning under Settings > Agents, tailoring how scanned tickets are read and processed for your business.

Order Importer: Department Support
The Order Importer now supports setting the Department field via ingest payloads.

───

Improvements

• Added São Paulo (America/Sao_Paulo) to the timezone picker in user settings
• Load summary validations are now supported on the web
• Reports now include the requested equipment type name field
• Reports now include external ID and ticket external vendor ID fields
• Driver Resource Usage Logs are now auto-generated when a hired-truck job reaches In Review

───

Bug Fixes

• Fixed invoice rate changes not syncing to jobs or line items
• Fixed material sell price edits on orders not reaching receivables or rate history
• Fixed sub-dispatched vendors incorrectly seeing the order creator's vendor rate
• Fixed rate edits silently failing when the login company differs from the dispatching company
• Fixed Ticket Approver role missing permissions needed to approve loads

• Fixed "Edit Rates" modal missing the Hauler Rate Type field

• Fixed searching in Receivables tab incorrectly switching back to the Payables tab
• Fixed Live Map panel styling and crashes caused by unexpected websocket data

Dispatch Rate Filters

Order Completed Notification

2026-08.label: August 2026
2026-08.narrative: August was about hardening the rates system end to end: rates on invoice-approved jobs were locked against manual edits, legacy freight rate cards stuck at stale prices became recoverable through the cascade, and the rate-change cascade reached mobile with a full impact preview. Parent companies gained consolidated settlement creation across child terminals, and drivers got order form autosave, GPS-stamped digital tickets, and a fix that stopped financial rates leaking to foremen.
